items.criterion: The world manifest carries every published project and nothing belonging to a draft.
items.judgment: Read the manifest and compare its slugs against the published rows.

items.criterion: A publish onto a world point a published project already holds is refused with the pinned error code and message.
items.judgment: Publish a draft at an occupied point and read the status and body.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous publishes for one world point leave exactly one published project there.
items.judgment: Fire both requests together and count the published rows at that point.

items.criterion: An unpublished project answers nothing at its own address to a caller with no owner token.
items.judgment: Request the draft slug anonymously and read the status.

items.criterion: An unpublished project's poster bytes are denied to a caller with no owner token.
items.judgment: Request the draft poster anonymously and read the status and payload.

items.criterion: The uploaded poster exists as a real object in the declared bucket at the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Read the stored key from the image row and look the object up in the bucket.

items.criterion: The published projects are ordered by the owner's adjacency relation.
items.judgment: Read the public list and compare its order against the adjacency chain.

items.criterion: The whisper wall never holds more than thirty rows.
items.judgment: Insert past the cap and count the rows.

items.criterion: A caller with no owner session is denied on every owner-only endpoint.
items.judgment: Call the studio write endpoints anonymously and read the statuses.

items.criterion: The served world document carries the root state classes and the prefixed behaviour hooks.
items.judgment: Read the first response for the state class families and the hook names.

items.criterion: The interface reads as a fine line drawing over the rendered scene rather than as filled cards.
items.judgment: A person looks at the world with an overlay open and decides.

items.criterion: Each surface leads with one primary action distinct from every secondary one.
items.judgment: A person opens each surface and decides whether one action leads.
